overview: The Medford City Council placed on file a resolution requesting free cash for school and municipal deficits, approved annual Community Preservation Act allocations, and passed resolutions regarding MBTA bus service and local infrastructure. The Council also received public comments on police department reform and accountability.

items.title: Resolution on Free Cash Usage for Budget Deficits
items.summary: Placed on file after Vice President Caraviello withdrew a resolution requesting the mayor appropriate free cash to address municipal and school budget deficits.

items.title: Annual Community Preservation Fund Allocation
items.summary: Approved the Community Preservation Committee's recommended annual allocation of $1,746,400 across statutory minimum categories, administration, and reserves.

items.title: Debt Service Supplemental Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a supplemental appropriation of $9,050.35 from bond premium reserves to the General Fund debt service account.

items.title: Commemorative Resolutions and Condolences
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for D-Day service members and dedicated the meeting in memory of late DPW employee Brian Rabbitt.

items.title: Report Request on Council Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved a request for the City Clerk to issue a report detailing all council-appointed board and commission members, term lengths, and expiration dates.

items.title: Inquiry on Property Status at 421 High Street
items.summary: Approved a request asking the Historical Commission for an update on the demolition status and condition of 421 High Street.

items.title: Local Infrastructure and Traffic Safety Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting street sign replacement at Spring Street Extension and Lambert Street, tree stump removal on Salem Street, and crosswalk repainting in Haines Square.

items.title: Request for MBTA Hearing on 325 and 326 Bus Routes
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an MBTA representative appear before the Council to address reported eliminations of the 325 and 326 bus routes.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Reports
items.summary: Approved committee reports concerning marijuana ordinance mapping, budget updates, and draft regulations for brewery tasting rooms.

items.title: Public Participation on Police Reform and Emergency Response
items.summary: Heard public comments advocating for use-of-force policy reforms and civilian oversight, alongside testimony commending police emergency response times.
